testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reopen customization from the custom panel title ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ And the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty ✔ When the user opens Customize from Tools ✔ And the user adds 2D Sketches to the Part Tools target ✔ And the user confirms the customization ✔ Then a User Commands panel is visible on Tools ✔ When the user right-clicks the User Commands panel title ✔ Then the context menu offers Ribbon Appearance, Show Panels, Customize User Commands, Undock Ribbon, and Docking Positions ✔ When the user selects Customize User Commands ✔ Then the Ribbon customization dialog opens with Part Tools selected ✔ And the target list contains 2D Sketches without a pending marker ✔ When the user removes 2D Sketches from the target list ✔ And the user confirms the customization ✔ Then the User Commands panel is removed
